_comment: Source of truth for Cambium families, models, board SKUs and FIT configurations. Used by build.sh (per-release manifest and FIT cross-check), select-config.sh and the project site. status values: validated, untested, not-built, no-build, refused (built, but must not be installed on this model). Only validated models may use the persistent or installer image; select-config.sh gives untested models the recovery (RAM) image only.

installer.note: Staged from the stock firmware in the inactive OEM bank and RAM-booted once; it refuses an installer whose NAND ECC is not the OEM software Hamming

persistent.note: 4 MiB raw kernel plus 44 MiB UBI per bank; first install writes only the inactive bank and preserves the running OEM bank; shared cambium-ab guard rearms healthy OpenWrt. Warm reboot and cold power-cycle passed

sysupgrade.note: Shared A/B after explicit conversion of the preserved OEM bank (verified off-device backup): sysupgrade 1->0 and 0->1 kept the configuration, and a failed-health trial rolled back automatically. Validated on one SKU 6 unit, not fleet or power-loss qualification
